lines.text: WoW: Forever now has its own section: Skyborne Heroic Pack $29.99, Epic Pack $59.99, Warcraft Forever Collection $79.99 (sold through Jan 11), and the $150 Collector's Edition restock already shows sold out

New Forever dates: PAX Aus keynote stream with a new dungeon deep dive Oct 8 at 6pm PDT, the Toronto Scarlet Monastery escape room Oct 8-11 with its Oct 23 stream, and Invite-A-Friend codes emailing from Oct 20
Midnight's Talebound game mode gets a PTR preview sometime in October, ahead of the Echoes of the Worldcore update
Hallow's End is now flagged as an estimate: Wowhead lists Oct 19 - Nov 2 while Darmory's US calendar lists Oct 18 - Nov 1, and Blizzard has not posted dates

needs_you.action: Finish the September Traveler's Log for the Crested Ember Leafmimic mount and spend or freeze Trader's Tender before the Trading Post rotates to October's stock Sep 30
Claim every LEGO Stores reward, including the stamp rally Pikachu and avatar jacket, by Sep 30 at 11:59pm local
The $4.99 Gigantamax Cinderace Max Battle Day ticket is only sold until Oct 3 at 5pm local, and its Timed Research must be finished during the 2-5pm event
Finish the Harvest Festival branching apple research and rank up its GO Pass by Oct 5 at 8pm local, then claim the pass rewards by Oct 7 at 8pm
Rank up GO Pass: September before rank earning stops Oct 6 at 10am local, using the uncapped GO Points on Oct 3 and 4; rewards expire Oct 8
Redeem the Chansey Plant code P0K0P1AGARDENS at a Pokemon Center PC before it stops working Oct 7
Evolve Zorua by 9pm local on Community Day for Zoroark's exclusive Fast Attack Sucker Punch; the $1.99 Special Research is only worth buying before the 2-5pm event
Complete and claim the free World Space Week Timed Research (Astronaut Pikachu) by Oct 12 at 11:59pm local
Hatch with the GO Pass Deluxe: September Timed Incubator before it expires Oct 13 at 10am local
Finish both Sandile Hatch Day Timed Researches, free and the $1.99 paid track, by 5pm local the same day, or their rewards are lost
Rank up GO Pass: Fall Marathon before it ends Oct 19 at 8pm local; unlocked rewards expire Oct 21 at 8pm

Visit a participating Best Buy, GameStop or Target to pick up the TCG 30th Celebration Timed Research by Oct 20 at 10pm local (claim by Nov 20); redeem a store-bought GO gift card by Oct 31 for the Gengar Knit Cap
Early Name Reservation opens Oct 27 (through Nov 3) for upgrade buyers; two-part names are region unique and go first come, first served
Rank up GO Pass: October before rank earning stops Nov 3 at 10am local, using the uncapped GO Points Oct 31 - Nov 1; rewards expire Nov 5, and the Deluxe Lucky Trinket must be used by Nov 8

games.typical_lead_time: in-game calendar visible 4+ weeks out; shop and patch news 1-2 weeks

timeline.title: Curse of Ula'tek
timeline.detail: The Coiled Isle is open with the Vaults of Atal'Utek, Curse Surges and Cursed Fishing, the Altar of Fangs dungeon, three new Delves, the Tidebound Grotto Lair, Housing Blueprints and four new neighborhood Endeavors.

timeline.title: Midnight Season 2 and the Venomous Abyss
timeline.detail: Season 2 continues with the eight-boss Venomous Abyss plus Mythic+, PvP Season 2 and Bountiful Delves; Season 3 was previewed at BlizzCon with no start date yet.

timeline.title: Trading Post: last call for September
timeline.detail: September's friendship rotation closes Sep 30: finish the Traveler's Log for the Crested Ember Leafmimic mount and spend or freeze Trader's Tender before the vendors change over.

timeline.title: Brewfest
timeline.detail: Brewfest runs through Oct 6 with the new Brewer's Purple and Red transmog sets, Brewfest housing decor, the Banquet outdoor scenario, new quests across Quel'Thalas, and daily Coren Direbrew runs.

timeline.title: Abyssal Crown Collection
timeline.detail: Azshara's Darkscale and Deepscale Raiment transmog sets and the Zothwing Darkseeker and Deepseeker mounts remain in the Battle.net Shop, sold as a bundle or individually.

timeline.title: Vibrant Petalweave Collection
timeline.detail: Four floral transmog ensembles (Sunlit, Blush, Azure, Scarlet) remain in the in-game Shop and on Battle.net, sold as a bundle or individually.

timeline.title: Trading Post: Costumed Calamity in October
timeline.detail: October's rotation is Halloween-flavored, with the Ensemble: Thornshadow Assassin's Attire as the Traveler's Log bonus reward; earn Tender all month and spend or freeze it by Oct 31.

timeline.title: Darkmoon Faire (October)
timeline.detail: The Faire reopens Oct 3 for its usual week of tickets, profession quests and carousel buffs.

timeline.title: Mists of Pandaria Timewalking
timeline.detail: The Mists of Pandaria dungeon rotation runs Oct 6-13 with Timewalking instances, the weekly quest and the Timewarped vendor.

timeline.title: The Great Gnomeregan Run (micro-holiday)
timeline.detail: Race a level-1 gnome from Gnomeregan to Booty Bay in the annual weekend fun run.

timeline.title: Hallow's End
timeline.detail: Hallow's End brings daily Headless Horseman runs for his mount, candy buckets across Azeroth, and the Tricky Treat vendors; Blizzard has not posted this year's dates yet.
timeline.estimate_basis: Wowhead calendar; Darmory's US calendar lists Oct 18 - Nov 1

timeline.title: Warlords of Draenor Timewalking
timeline.detail: The Warlords of Draenor dungeon rotation runs Oct 27 - Nov 3, scaling dungeons and rewards to your level from 10 up.

timeline.title: Talebound preview on the PTR
timeline.detail: Midnight's new Talebound mode, a solo or group action-RPG romp through four macabre tales with its own Slayer, Inquisitor and Witch classes, gets an early PTR preview sometime in October ahead of the Echoes of the Worldcore update.
timeline.estimate_basis: Blizzard says "sometime in October"; no PTR date posted

timeline.title: Midnight 12.1.5: The Promise of Tomorrow
timeline.detail: The next content update, on the PTR with no release date announced, concludes the Quel'thalas saga with the one-boss Unbinding of Kith'ix raid, Labyrinths, Aqir Invasions and Ascendant Venomstones.
timeline.estimate_basis: On the PTR; Blizzard has not announced a release date

weekly_rhythm: Week of Sep 29 (now): World Quest Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Deep Six; September's Trading Post closes Sep 30 and October's opens Oct 1; Darkmoon Faire opens Oct 3
Week of Oct 6: Mists of Pandaria Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Arathi Blizzard; Brewfest ends Oct 6; Darkmoon Faire through Oct 10; Gnomeregan Run Oct 10-12
Week of Oct 13: Battleground and Pet Battle Bonus Events; PvP Brawl: Gravity Lapse; Hallow's End begins Oct 19 per Wowhead (Oct 18 per Darmory)
Week of Oct 20: Delves Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Deepwind Dunk; Talebound PTR preview expected during October
Week of Oct 27: Warlords of Draenor Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Shado-Pan Showdown; Hallow's End ends Nov 2; Day of the Dead Nov 1-3
Nov 3 (window end): Midnight Dungeon Event and PvP Brawl: Warsong Scramble begin at reset
just_past_window: Nov 3-10: Midnight Dungeon Event and PvP Brawl: Warsong Scramble
Nov 10-17: Arena Skirmish Bonus Event and PvP Brawl: Cooking Impossible; Moonkin Festival Nov 12-13
Nov 17: WoW's 22nd Anniversary begins (through Dec 8), alongside a Timewalking week and PvP Brawl: Temple of Hotmogu

games.typical_lead_time: Blizzard posts Forever news 1-3 weeks ahead; launch and phase timing set at BlizzCon

timeline.title: WoW: Forever beta
timeline.detail: The beta runs through Oct 21, the last full day of testing, for opt-in invitees and Skyborne Epic Pack or Warcraft Forever Collection buyers; the level cap is 20, rising to 30 later, with more zones, dungeons, the new battleground and a public Server Slam window still to come.

timeline.title: Pre-purchase upgrades: Heroic, Epic, Collection
timeline.detail: Forever itself comes with any subscription; the optional Skyborne Heroic Pack is $29.99, the Skyborne Epic Pack $59.99 (beta access, 30 days of Game Time from Nov 4) and the Warcraft Forever Collection $79.99 (adds Warcraft III: Reforged and the Forsaken Kingdom campaign), with the Collection sold only through Jan 11, 2027.

timeline.title: Collector's Edition ($150)
timeline.detail: The physical Collector's Edition (13-inch Dwarf and Bear statue, mousepad, prints, pins, journal and a Warcraft Forever Collection code) was restocked Sep 24 but shows Sold Out on the Blizzard Gear Store at last check; restock orders ship February 2027, one per household.

timeline.title: PAX Aus keynote: new Forever dungeon deep dive
timeline.detail: Watch Holly Longdale's Storytime keynote and Clay Stone's deep dive on a new WoW: Forever dungeon live on the Warcraft or PAX Twitch channel Oct 8 from 6:00 to 7:30 p.m. PDT; the Forever booth offers beta hands-on at PAX Aus Oct 9-11 AEDT.

timeline.title: Escape Together: Scarlet Monastery escape room
timeline.detail: Book the Scarlet Monastery-inspired escape room at Escape Manor on King Street, Toronto, Oct 8-11, then watch the Horde vs Alliance showdown stream Oct 23 on the Warcraft Twitch and YouTube channels (stream time not yet announced).

timeline.title: Invite-A-Friend Launch Codes start emailing
timeline.detail: Codes from qualifying pre-purchases (one with the Heroic Pack, three with the Epic Pack or Collection) email out from Oct 20 PST; forward each to a friend, who redeems it on Battle.net to play launch week Nov 4-11 with no subscription, beta not included.

timeline.title: Early Name Reservation
timeline.detail: Create and customize up to three characters and lock in two-part names, unique per region and first come, first served, with any Forever upgrade purchase before the Nov 4 launch.

weekly_rhythm: Beta cadence: realm restarts and Known Issues posts land most weekdays on the Forever forums (see the Wowhead Blue Tracker); the level cap rises from 20 to 30 later in the test
Launch day is Nov 4 at 3:00 p.m. PST for all regions; Epic Pack and Collection buyers get 30 days of Game Time added that day
Per Wowhead's roadmap: 4 new zones, 9 new dungeons and the Skyborne race at launch, the first three raids Dec 9, Hardcore ruleset winter 2026
just_past_window: Nov 4: WoW: Forever launches globally at 3:00 p.m. PST; access is included with any WoW subscription or Game Time
Nov 4-11: Launch week for Invite-A-Friend guests; Early Name Reservation closes Nov 3

games.typical_lead_time: events usually announced 1-4 weeks ahead; season schedule posted at season start

timeline.title: Season 24: Twilight Trails
timeline.detail: The season runs to Dec 1 with more Paldea debuts including Maschiff and Mabosstiff, Mega Evolution debuts for Staraptor and Chandelure, and Dynamax Rhyhorn, Sneasel and Sizzlipede in Max Battles.

timeline.title: GO Pass: September
timeline.detail: Rank toward a Latios encounter; GO Points are uncapped Oct 3-4, rank earning ends Oct 6 at 10am local, rewards expire Oct 8 at 10am, and the Rank 20 Timed Incubator expires Oct 13.

timeline.title: GO Battle League: Twilight Trails
timeline.detail: Mega-Evolved Pokemon are eligible in the new Mega Editions of all three leagues this season, with a free Timed Research Pass, Ryme-inspired avatar items and a guaranteed Pikachu Libre rank-up encounter.

timeline.title: LEGO Stores and Pokemon GO
timeline.detail: Last call: everything from the US LEGO Stores tie-in, including the stamp rally Special Background Pikachu and the LEGO avatar jacket and cap, must be claimed by Sep 30 at 11:59pm local.

timeline.title: adidas | Pokemon Timed Research
timeline.detail: Open the app at a participating adidas store to pick up Timed Research for an adidas avatar jacket and cap plus a Lucario encounter and Mega Energy; research is available through Jan 15 and must be claimed by Feb 13, 2027.

timeline.title: Pokemon TCG 30th Celebration
timeline.detail: Participating US Best Buy, GameStop and Target stores host boosted Mega Gengar raids and in-store Timed Research through Oct 20 at 10pm local; redeeming a GO gift card bought there by Oct 31 adds the Gengar Knit Cap avatar item.

timeline.title: Harvest Festival: Applin Picking
timeline.detail: Shiny Applin debuts, Mossy Lures dispense Tart, Sweet and Syrupy Apples, and a branching apple Timed Research plus an event GO Pass ($4.99 Deluxe, $6.99 with 6 ranks) run to Oct 5 at 8pm local, with pass rewards claimable through Oct 7.

timeline.title: Harvest Festival: Taken Over
timeline.detail: Team GO Rocket floods PokeStops and balloons from Oct 2 at 12:00am to Oct 5 at 8pm local; chase Giovanni with the GO Pass Super Rocket Radar to save Shadow Zekrom, hatch the debuting Shiny Shroodle, and TM away Frustration.

timeline.title: Gigantamax Cinderace Max Battle Day
timeline.detail: Gigantamax Cinderace fills six-star Max Battles with Shiny Gigantamax Cinderace debuting; all Power Spots host Gigantamax Battles with 8x Max Particles, a $4.99 ticket (sold until 5pm local) adds Timed Research and 2x Max Battle XP, and the remote raid limit rises to 20 from Oct 2 at 5pm to Oct 3 at 8pm PDT.

timeline.title: World Space Week
timeline.detail: Astronaut Pikachu debuts in one-star raids and free Timed Research from Oct 4 at 12:00am to Oct 10 at 11:59pm local; the research must be completed and claimed by Oct 12 at 11:59pm.

timeline.title: GO Pass: October
timeline.detail: Rank toward a Kyogre encounter, with the one-use Lucky Trinket back as the Deluxe capper ($7.99, or $9.99 with 10 ranks); GO Points are uncapped Oct 31 - Nov 1, rank earning ends Nov 3 at 10am local, rewards expire Nov 5, and the Trinket must be used by Nov 8.

timeline.title: Zorua Community Day
timeline.detail: Zorua swarms with boosted Shiny odds and Special Backgrounds from 2pm to 5pm local; evolve by 9pm for Zoroark's Fast Attack Sucker Punch, with a $1.99 Special Research and Zorua drawn to regular Lures until 9pm.

timeline.title: Fall Marathon: Buddy Trek
timeline.detail: Bramblin debuts via Incense and GO Pass tasks, Mega Manectric gains Super Max and Discharge+, and a week-long event GO Pass ($4.99 Deluxe, $6.99 with 6 ranks) runs Oct 13 at 10am to Oct 19 at 8pm local, with rewards expiring Oct 21.

timeline.title: Sandile Hatch Day
timeline.detail: Sandile hatches from 2 km Eggs with boosted Shiny odds, 2x hatch Candy and half hatch distance; free Timed Research awards an Incubator, and a $1.99 paid track adds quarter hatch distance plus two Super Incubators, all to be finished by 5pm local.

timeline.title: Dynamax Max Battle Day
timeline.detail: A Dynamax Max Battle Day runs Oct 24 from 2pm to 5pm local; the featured Pokemon has not been announced yet.

timeline.title: Halloween 2026 Part I
timeline.detail: Halloween Part I runs Oct 27 at 10am through Oct 31 at 8pm local; contents are not announced yet, with Part II following Nov 1-5.

timeline.title: Super Mega Raid Day (October)
timeline.detail: A Super Mega Raid Day runs Oct 31 from 2pm to 5pm local, mid-Halloween; the featured Mega has not been announced yet.

timeline.title: Halloween 2026 Part II
timeline.detail: Halloween Part II opens Nov 1 at 10am and runs past the window to Nov 5 at 8pm local; contents are not announced yet.

weekly_rhythm: Spotlight Hour is Thursdays 6-7pm local; Raid Hour is Wednesdays 6-7pm local; Max Monday runs 6am-9pm local
Spotlight Hours: Seedot Oct 1; Elgyem Oct 8; Stufful Oct 15; Morelull Oct 22; Gastly Oct 29
Max Mondays: Sizzlipede Oct 5; Rookidee Oct 12; Sneasel Oct 19; Sableye Oct 26
5-star raids: Xurkitree, Pheromosa and Buzzwole through Sep 29; Xerneas Sep 30 - Oct 6; Yveltal Oct 7-13; Dialga Oct 14-20; Palkia Oct 21-27; Giratina (Origin) Oct 28 - Nov 3
Raid Hours: Xerneas Sep 30; Yveltal Oct 7; Dialga Oct 14; Palkia Oct 21; Giratina (Origin) Oct 28

Mega Raids: Victreebel Sep 30 - Oct 6; Blastoise Oct 7-13; Dragonite Oct 14-20; Charizard X and Y Oct 21-27; Sableye Oct 28 - Nov 3; Shadow Thundurus in weekend Shadow Raids through Oct 6, then Shadow Landorus
GO Battle League: Mega Color Cup Sep 29 - Oct 6; Mega Editions of all three leagues Oct 6-13; Little Cup Oct 13-20; Fantasy Cup Oct 20-27; Mega Halloween Cup Oct 27 - Nov 3
Season 24's remaining Community Days are Oct 10 (Zorua) and Nov 21; City Safari Boston is postponed for weather with ticket sales closed and a new date pending
just_past_window: Nov 6-8: Pokemon GO Wild Area 2026 in-person events in Sendai and Mexico City (ticketed, on-site)
Nov 14-15: Pokemon GO Wild Area 2026: Global

games.typical_lead_time: in-game events announced only 4-7 days ahead; DLC and update news months ahead

timeline.title: PokemonXP and Worlds Cloud Island
timeline.detail: Grab the mysterious goggles from any Pokemon Center in an area at environment level 3 or above and enter address JW7MXKP2 to tour the Worlds stage island; no end date has been announced.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Chansey Plant
timeline.detail: Enter code P0K0P1AGARDENS at any Pokemon Center PC (Mystery Gift, code entry) for a placeable Chansey Plant; codes are region free and valid through Oct 7.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Ditto Rug
timeline.detail: Claim the Ditto Rug at any Pokemon Center PC via the internet Mystery Gift option, no code needed; available through Jan 31, 2027.

timeline.title: Expansion Pass: Part 1 out now
timeline.detail: The $34.99 three-part pass is live on the eShop with Part 1, Bubbly Basin, which needs the Bleak Beach environment request plus the free Dive move; buying by Aug 31, 2027 also emails a code for 30 rare Pokemetal ingots.

just_past_window: Expansion Pass Part 2 arrives in late 2026 with accessories, new furniture and Pokemon but no new town; Part 3 and its new town follow in 2027

games.typical_lead_time: official news posts land 1-2 weeks ahead; dates confirmed by Pawprint

timeline.title: Windchaser's Departure: Irisalis debuts
timeline.detail: The Legendary Journey season runs Sep 25 10:00 to Dec 9 19:59 UTC-4 on Aniimo-Americas: collect weekly Iris Petals to craft the Legendary Aniipod for Irisalis, then a guaranteed-capture Aniipod with Perfect Innate Potential and Sparkling Form.

timeline.title: Carry over your beta rewards
timeline.detail: At the first-login Link Email prompt, enter the email you used for betas, pre-registration or web events and verify it, or those rewards and Bonded Promise eggs stay on the old account; check what you are owed at aniimo.com/act/rebate.

timeline.title: Glamour Star: Floral Soiree
timeline.detail: Dress an Aniimo to the Floral Soiree audition theme and submit it for scoring before the event ends Oct 2 at 03:59 UTC-4; score milestones pay out rewards.

timeline.title: Aniimo Discovery
timeline.detail: Track a brand-new Aniimo across Idyll with periodically refilled free Search Attempts (unspent free attempts do not stack) and research quests that unlock Search Buffs; runs to Oct 9 at 03:59 UTC-4.

timeline.title: Vein Abundance spawns
timeline.detail: Prismana Form Melloblum appears at Rosetower Woods Sep 28 - Oct 5, then Prismana Form Waleetle at Berylline Vale Oct 5-12 (switching at 04:00 UTC-4).

timeline.title: Journey Chronicles login event
timeline.detail: Log in on enough days between Oct 1 and Oct 29 (04:00 UTC-4) to claim the full set of travel gifts.

weekly_rhythm: Holo-Battle Interlink runs weekly from Thursday 04:00 to Monday 03:59 server time, with Star Rank and Support rewards resetting each cycle
Egg Heist Chaos Mode is open for Tier IV Elite Egg Seekers and costs a Chaos Ticket per run
Shop features the Radiant Waveglow appearance set (980 Lumin Crystals) and the Laurel Moon Blessing pack (280)
